pairs.question: Prima theologia maxime accommodata est ad theatrum, secunda ad mundum, tertia ad urbem. Quis non uideat, cui palmam dederit?
pairs.answer: Vtique secundae, quam supra dixit esse philosophorum.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question with its own answer. The Varro quotation 'Prima theologia maxime accommodata est ad theatrum, secunda ad mundum, tertia ad urbem' is kept verbatim as setup so that 'cui palmam dederit' (to which of the three) has a referent; the framing tag 'inquit' inside it is dropped as narration. The interrogative is 'Quis non uideat, cui palmam dederit?' Answer ends at the first full stop ('...philosophorum.'); what follows ('Hanc enim pertinere testatur ad mundum...') elaborates rather than answers, so it is cut.

pairs.question: Placetne tandem uitam aeternam peti aut sperari ab diis poeticis theatricis, ludicris scaenicis?
pairs.answer: Absit; immo auertat Deus uerus tam inmanem sacrilegamque dementiam.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question answered emphatically by the author. The non-answering preamble 'Sequestrata igitur paululum theologia, quam naturalem uocant, de qua postea disserendum est' is dropped from the start; the operative interrogative 'placetne tandem...scaenicis?' is kept (first word capitalized). The answer 'Absit; immo auertat Deus uerus tam inmanem sacrilegamque dementiam.' runs to the first full stop; the next sentence ('Quid? ab eis diis...') opens a new question and is excluded.
